items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTU1ODU4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--9f5a7221cf8832db6f2da83028976cea1b1af779/Dise%C3%B1o%20sin%20t%C3%ADtulo.png) # ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTU1ODc4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--18060881a66047ac835561d05342fd047ac3d212/1.png) ​ Esta competencia tendrá **solo el evento 3x3x3 Menos Movimientos**, y se llevará a cabo en múltiples ubicaciones en América del Sur. ¡Preste atención a la **fecha y zona horaria** de su [ubicación](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCSAC2026#70836-lugares-locations)! ​ Se pueden agregar ubicaciones hasta el **15 de mayo** a las 23:59 UTC, por lo que si aún no hay una ubicación cerca de usted, comuníquese con su [Delegado](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/delegates#latin-america) local en América del Sur. ------ # ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTU1ODc5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--e3bf799ef8ade32ca1b076892fb8907ef8205981/2.png) ​ Esta competição contará **apenas com a modalidade 3x3x3 Menos Movimentos** e será realizada em vários locais da América do Sul. Preste atenção à **data e fuso horário** da sua [localidade](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCSAC2026#70836-lugares-locations)! ​ Os locais podem ser adicionados até **15 de maio** às 23h59 UTC, portanto, se ainda não houver um local próximo a você, entre em contato com o [Delegado](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/delegates#latin-america) local na América do Sul. --- # ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTU1ODgwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--89fe33b4e47263997451d2f790cd9ac7e9de0193/3.png) ​ This competition will hold **only 3x3x3 Fewest Moves event**, and it will be held in multiple locations, across South America. Please pay attention to the **date and time zone** of your [location](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCSAC2026#70836-lugares-locations)! ​ Locations may be added until the **15th of May** 23:59UTC so if there isn't a location near you yet contact your local [Delegate](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/delegates#latin-america) in South America. ​ ---
